verses.1: And after answering, Jesus said again to them in parables:
verses.2: The kingdom of heaven became a reality for a human king, as long as he arranged marriages for his son.
verses.3: And he sent his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding, but they did not want to go.
verses.4: Once again, he sent out other servants, saying, “Tell those who were summoned that my bride is ready; my beloved ones and all the preparations are complete. Now go and prepare for the wedding.”
verses.5: But those who were lazy went away. Some went to their own fields, while others continued to work in their businesses.
verses.6: But the rest, having kept his slaves, abused and killed them.
verses.7: But the king became angry. He sent his troops to attack them, and he defeated those warriors as well as their city.
verses.8: Then he says to his servants, “The marriage is ready. But those who were called upon to get married are not worthy of it.”
verses.9: Therefore, proceed along the paths of those roads. And whenever you find anyone suitable, invite them to get married.
verses.10: And when those slaves went out, they brought along with them all those they found along their way, both the good and the evil. And so, the marriage was ruined.
verses.11: When the king entered, he saw that those who were lying there were not dressed in wedding attire.
verses.12: And he said to him, “Friend, how did you get here without any wedding attire?” He was shocked.
verses.13: Then the king said to the vendors, “Wipe his feet and hands clean before throwing him into the darkness outside. There, he will suffer torment and pain.”
verses.14: Many, after all, are called upon to serve; few, however, are truly chosen.
verses.15: Then, the Pharisees took counsel with each other on how to deceive him with their words.
verses.16: And they sent to him their disciples, along with the philosophers. They said, “Teacher, we know that you truly teach the way of God. You do not deceive anyone; you indeed see people’s true nature.”
verses.17: So, what do you think about this? Is it appropriate to give a gift to Kaisaria?
verses.18: But Jesus knew their wickedness and said, “What are you trying to deceive me with?”
verses.19: You have shown me the coin of the king. They then paid him a fine in exchange for it.
verses.20: And he said to them, “What is this image, and what is this symbol?”
verses.21: They say to him, “Cesar.” Then he says to them, “So, honor the Cesar as a Cesar, and honor God as God.”
verses.22: And when they heard this, they were amazed. Then, after dismissing him, they left.
verses.23: On that day, the Sadducees came to him, saying that there would be no resurrection. They also asked him questions.
verses.24: They said, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If anyone dies without having any children, his brother shall take his wife as a wife for him, and he shall become the father of his brother’s children.’”
verses.25: There were seven brothers with us. The first brother died, and he did not have any children; therefore, he left his wife to his brother.
verses.26: Similarly, the second and third ones as well, until seven in total.
verses.28: In this transformation, who will be the woman among the seven? For everyone else would take her place.
verses.29: But when Jesus spoke to them, he said, “Do not be deceived by those who do not know the writings or the power of God.”
verses.30: For in this state, they neither marry nor are married. Instead, they act like angels of God in heaven.
verses.31: But regarding the resurrection of the dead, you do not know what God has said to you.
verses.32: I am the God Abraham, and I am also the God Isaac and the God Jacob. There is no god for the dead; instead, there is only a god who lives among the living.
verses.33: And when the crowd heard his teachings, they were amazed by them.
verses.34: When the Pharisees heard that he had healed the sick, they gathered around him.
verses.35: And one of them asked him a legal question.
verses.36: Teacher, what is the greatest commandment in the law?
verses.37: And he said to him, “Love your Lord God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.”
verses.38: This is the first and most important commandment.
verses.39: The second day will be the same as today. Love your neighbor as yourself.
verses.40: In these difficult circumstances, the entire law is violated, as well as the prophecies.
verses.41: Then, along with the Pharisees, Jesus questioned them.
verses.42: He said, “What do you think about Christ? Who is he?” They replied, “He’s David.”
verses.43: He says to them: “How then can David call him ‘Lord’ in his spirit?”
verses.44: He said to my master, “Sit to my right until I have defeated your enemies beneath your feet.”
verses.45: If David calls him “Lord”, then how can he be his son?
verses.46: And no one was able to speak against him. No one dared to challenge him that day anymore.
